rubric: Refers to the three 50 ml marks
checks.stimulus: The jug is marked every 50 ml. Liquid reaches the third mark. How many millilitres are in the jug?

evidence_criteria: Counts the 50 ml marks instead of estimating
objectives.title: Read the marks on a measuring jug

checks.stimulus: One batch uses 175 ml. You make two batches of the same size. How much juice do you need?

evidence_criteria: Adds the single batch quantity to itself
objectives.title: Double a recipe quantity and explain the operation

safety_notes: Uses water and a jug; no heat, sharp tools or hazardous materials.
subtitle: A ten-minute parent-led measurement practice with a separate answer guide.
title: Parent demo: measuring ingredients together
